name: within_cell_gaussian_rank_copula
dependence_scope: The same positive Gaussian-copula dependence is assumed within each of the four cells.
parameter_status: The latent correlation of 0.8 is an explicit, uncalibrated working assumption, not an estimate from the supplied study.
marginal_policy: Preserve the supplied right and left arrays exactly. Do not regenerate, truncate, rescale, or pool them.
pairing_law: For a cell of size m, assign standard-normal scores to right-hand ranks using midpoint probabilities (i+0.5)/m. Generate independent standard-normal residuals and form left latent scores as rho times the right score plus sqrt(1-rho^2) times the residual. Assign the sorted left values in the rank order of these latent scores.
weighting: Equal representation of the four cells; not source-population weighting.
measurement_unit: kg; each hand value represents the mean of three trials, not a single trial.
interpretation: One reproducible working generator for virtual pairs, not reconstruction of source participants or identification of their bilateral dependence.
